verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents several first-party SDKs for building on Workers. The Agents SDK (`npm install agents`) provides stateful agents, the Sandbox SDK provides isolated code execution, `@cloudflare/think` is an agent harness, and the Agents SDK handles MPP payments. All are positioned for AI-native, agentic development. missing for 10: evidence of general-purpose Cloudflare REST API client SDKs across multiple languages (only an OpenAPI spec is probed), and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Agents are persistent, stateful execution environments for agentic workloads, powered by Cloudflare Durable Objects.
The Sandbox SDK enables you to run untrusted code securely in isolated environments.
Built on Containers, Sandbox SDK provides a simple API for executing commands, managing files, running background processes, and exposing services — all from your Workers applications.
`@cloudflare/think` lets you build a stateful AI chat agent — one that streams replies, remembers the conversation, and calls tools — by extending a single base class.
Use the Cloudflare Agents SDK to pay MPP services.
